sentences.text: No: the documents do not state that a 2% pre-payment charge in this Rs 80 lakh MSE sanction letter is a violation for a Tier 3 UCB, because loans for business purpose to Micro and Small Enterprises with sanctioned amount / limit up to ₹50 lakh are the category with a ban, and this loan is above that amount.
For cases other than those in paragraph 261(1) and (2), pre-payment charges, if any, shall be as per the approved policy of a UCB, and for term loans they shall be based on the amount being prepaid.

The applicability or otherwise of pre-payment charges shall be clearly disclosed in the sanction letter and loan agreement, and no pre-payment charges which have not been disclosed as specified herein shall be charged by a UCB.
